title: Register recovery environment declaration in the governance control plane

phases.objective: Close the exact-path registration gap that caused the recovery access-repair declaration to raise a blocking governance objection while preserving mandatory manual merge review for critical surfaces.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Policy Objection CI evaluates a change containing a registered critical E2E declaration
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact declaration is recognized as a canonical control-plane path, blocking_count remains zero, manual_count remains one, and autonomous merge remains forbidden.
steps: Classify the E2E declaration as a critical governance-control-plane path.
Resolve the exact path against Constitution.control_plane_paths.
Emit the non-waiverable manual-merge objection without emitting changed-critical-path-unregistered.
Require the existing exact-head Single Owner Review Gate before a human merge decision.
assertions: The recovery access-repair declaration is registered exactly.
This repair declaration is also registered exactly and cannot recreate the same bootstrap failure.
Registered critical changes do not produce a blocking registration objection.
Registered critical changes still disable autonomous merge.
No GitHub policy, deployment, database, provider or credential mutation is performed by this change.
